purpose: Preserve the canonical G8 Macro information as a multidimensional structural profile before central-bank reaction and market transmission. Avoid collapsing growth, labour and inflation into a premature universal FX polarity.

semantics.state: Structural level/state produced by the existing canonical Macro layer; preserve numerically and do not reinterpret as an FX score.
semantics.momentum: Current block impulse; preserve separately from structural level.
semantics.direction: Observed block direction UP/DOWN/FLAT; variable direction only, not automatic FX judgement.
semantics.velocity_percentile: How unusual the current speed is relative to the block history.
semantics.acceleration_percentile: How unusual the change in speed is relative to history.
semantics.persistence: Whether the directional move is fresh, confirmed or mixed/near zero.
semantics.candidate_p70: Early warning only; never a mechanical override.

architecture: canonical Macro block profile: growth + labour + inflation

inflation_rule.reason: The same inflation direction can imply different FX consequences depending on starting level, growth/labour context and the currency-specific central-bank reaction function.
inflation_rule.required_path: inflation block -> currency-specific reaction function -> front-end transmission

evidence: Frozen runtime contains static currency Macro labels used by deriveCurrencyState.
Historical methodology commits explicitly separate structural Macro from temporal lead, surprise, COT and price confirmation.
